label: No self-giving of being from no efficient self-causation, via a self-edge bridge
summary: Target: the strict no-self-giving premise 0e473dc4 (NoSelfGivingOnAccessible) of the nonexternal causal Arrival B route (result 9e5124a2, attempt 9d141c6c), toward e4a3b917, b19ffd92 and STMT-GOD-EXISTS. Horizontal support from the Second Way family. Spec: specs/concurrent-giving-priority-bridge.toml; PR #1863, stacked on #1856. RESULTS. (1) caed414d (argument 3b57de88, noSelfGivingFromNoSelfCause): the existing no-efficient-self-cause node 8b2561cd plus one OPEN self-edge bridge 0e961fde (SelfGivingIsEfficientSelfCause: GivesAt v c c t implies EfficientlyCausesIn c c esse) give 0e473dc4. (2) 15e3a176 (argument ae6a8763, noSelfGivingFromEfficientPriority): the same bridge plus the Second Way priority premises e078f07b and 32d77f18, through the verified SelfCausationPriority.noSelfCauseFromPriority with the shared frame field PriorSimply (PRIOR_1, 1d9aa4d9), give 0e473dc4. (3) controls: in MetricBeginningArrival.Control.selfGivingFrame efficient causation and PriorSimply are empty, so both priority premises hold while the bridge and no-self-giving fail; a logical omission control only. READING (repair after the independent semantic challenge on #1863): the bridge maps GivesAt, indexed to any history v of the frame and a moment t, to the index-free EfficientlyCausesIn. On the here-and-now gloss of EFFICIENT_CAUSING_2 (69c0b23e) self-giving in a merely possible history would become an actual present efficient self-cause, which is not intended. Both routes therefore read EfficientlyCausesIn world- and time-neutrally (in some history at some moment) and use 8b2561cd and e078f07b under that modal reading (nothing is, in any history, its own efficient cause; whatever is in some history an efficient cause of x is simply prior to x); 32d77f18 concerns only the unindexed PriorSimply. That reading is stronger than their actual-world gloss; the source's 'nec est possibile' (q.2 a.3) is a candidate basis for the modal reading of 8b2561cd, attribution deferred and not checked. REJECTED APPROACHES. Restricting the bridge to histories accessible from the selected world: it would edit the frozen Challenge's theorem types and would not remove the need for the modal reading, since the consequent stays index-free. Reusing the existing efficient-esse bridge DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (8934912c): it passes from CausesIn to the tenseless EfficientlyCausesEsse only for a cause distinct from its effect, so it cannot cover the self-edge, and its source relation is CausesIn, not GivesAt. No formal sense_bridges entry is declared: GivesAt (158301bc) is the carrier of the CAUSE_OF_BEING senses, not itself a sense of a disambiguation that also contains EFFICIENT_CAUSING_2, so the passage is recorded as the explicit premise 0e961fde with disambiguations 88a8fba7 and c3c01e92 linked. OBJECTION AUDIT: no substantive objection identified to the self-edge bridge beyond the reading issue above; it remains OPEN. Given #1856's equivalence (under 0e473dc4 and d3184c66 the nonexternal premise 2a4d99d8 is equivalent to e4a3b917), supporting 0e473dc4 does not discriminate against a rival who denies that a necessary concretum is possible. No premise is established.
blocker: OPEN: warrant for the self-edge bridge 0e961fde (that strict self-giving of being would be efficient self-causation in respect esse), and for the modal, world- and time-neutral reading of 8b2561cd and e078f07b on which both routes rely. Structural next test: index the efficient relation by world, state a modal sibling of 8b2561cd ('in every accessible history nothing efficiently causes itself') with attribution deferred, and rebuild the two routes on it, so the modal reading becomes a typed premise rather than a reading note.
